$comment: What Conversational BI needs from the host monorepo. Kept in sync with server/package.json by a test (depsManifest.test.ts). The versions are the ones tested here; for the Mastra packages the host's lockfile decides (see `mastra`).

@ai-sdk/anthropic.why: Anthropic model access (only used when LLM_BASE_URL is not set)

@mastra/core.why: Agents, tools and the HTTP server; needs Node 22.13 or later. Version: the host decides, from one Mastra release set

@mastra/libsql.why: Mastra's own storage for agent runs (LibSQL file or in-memory); the chat history comes from the UI. Version: the host decides, from one Mastra release set

dotenv.why: Reads server/.env in local development only

zod.why: Request, event and settings validation. Version 4: check GC's zod version before merging into one root package.json

mastra.why: Mastra CLI: build and dev server. Version: the host decides, from the same Mastra release set

mastra.rule: The host's lockfile decides the Mastra versions. Install one release set: the packages below must all come from the same Mastra release. Their version numbers are independent counters, so match them by release date, not by number. Pin @mastra/deployer and @mastra/server to @mastra/core's version (overrides), or the CLI pulls the newest ones and the server fails at start-up. Check a set with server/scripts/compat-check.mjs (docs/lift/MASTRA-COMPAT.md).
